26700.meaning1: arising of a thought; inclination of the mind; intention (towards)

examples.text: citt'uppādam'pi kho ahaṃ, cunda, kusalesu dhammesu bahukāraṃ vadāmi, ko pana vādo kāyena vācāya anuvidhīyanāsu.

26702.meaning1: way of inclining the mind; method of setting intention

examples.text: iti kho, cunda, desito mayā sallekhapariyāyo, desito citt'uppādapariyāyo, desito parikkamanapariyāyo, desito uparibhāgapariyāyo, desito parinibbānapariyāyo. yaṃ kho, cunda, satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hit'esinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya, kataṃ vo taṃ mayā.

26703.meaning1: display of intention; demonstration of one's intent

examples.text: kiṃ pana tvaṃ, mahārāja, atthavasaṃ sampassamāno imasmiṃ sarīre evarūpaṃ paramanipaccakāraṃ karosi, citt'ūpahāraṃ upadaṃsesī'ti?

26704.meaning1: one remains within the mind, closely observing the mind
26704.commentary: (PM) kathaṃ citte citt'ānupassī viharati? idh'ekacco sarāgaṃ cittaṃ aniccato anupassati, no niccato… paṭinissajjati, no ādiyati. aniccato anupassanto niccasaññaṃ pajahati… paṭinissajjanto ādānaṃ pajahati. imehi sattahi ākārehi cittaṃ anupassati. cittaṃ upaṭṭhānaṃ, no sati.

examples.text: yaṃ vattaṃ paripūrento, sīlam'pi paripūrati, visuddhasīlo sappañño, citte'kaggam'pi vindati.
paṭhamaṃ kho, āvuso, jhānaṃ pañc'aṅgikaṃ. idh'āvuso, paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa bhikkhuno vitakko ca vattati, vicāro ca pīti ca sukhañ'ca citt'ek'aggatā ca.

26707.meaning1: having a degree of mental unification

26708.meaning2: gaining mental unification; attaining oneness of mind

26709.meaning1: pleasure of mental unification; ease of unity of mind

examples.text: so vat'ānanda, bhikkhu saṅgaṇik'ārāmo saṅgaṇikarato saṅgaṇik'ārāmataṃ anuyutto gaṇ'ārāmo gaṇarato gaṇasammudito yaṃ taṃ nekkhammasukhaṃ pavivekasukhaṃ upasamasukhaṃ sambodhisukhaṃ citt'ek'aggatāsukhaṃ tassa sukhassa nikāmalābhī bhavissati akicchalābhī akasiralābhī'ti, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.

26711.meaning1: beautiful thing; delightful thing; something wonderful; (comm) various sense objects

examples.text: n'ete kāmā yāni citrāni loke, saṅkapparāgo purisassa kāmo, tiṭṭhanti citrāni tath'eva loke. ath'ettha dhīrā vinayanti chandan'ti.
kāmā hi citrā madhurā manoramā, aviddasū yattha sitā puthujjanā, te dukkham'icchanti punabbhav'esino, cittena nītā niraye nirākatā.

26713.commentary: (DNa) citrā supaṇṇā iti tesa nāman'ti tesaṃ citrasupaṇṇā'ti nāmaṃ. (DNt) citrasupaṇṇā'ti nāmaṃ vicitrasundarapattavantatāya.

examples.text: ye nāgarāje sahasā haranti, dibbā dijā pakkhi visuddhacakkhū, vehāyasā te vanam'ajjhapattā, citrā supaṇṇā iti tesa nāmaṃ.

seyyathā'pi, sāḷha, yodh'ājīvo bahūni ce'pi kaṇḍacitrakāni jānāti, atha kho so tīhi ṭhānehi rāj'āraho hoti rājabhoggo, rañño aṅgan't'eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati. katamehi tīhi? dūrepātī ca, akkhaṇavedhī ca, mahato ca kāyassa padāletā.

26718.meaning1: with colourful plumage; with beautiful feathers

examples.text: nanu ahaṃ citta tay'āmhi yācito, giribbaje citrachadā vihaṅ'gamā, mahindaghosa-tthanit'ābhigajjino, te taṃ ramessanti vanamhi jhāyinaṃ.

te evarūpaṃ maṇḍana-vibhūsanaṭṭhān'ānuyogaṃ anuyuttā viharanti, seyyath'idaṃ… hatthabandhaṃ sikhābandhaṃ daṇḍaṃ nāḷikaṃ asiṃ chattaṃ citr'upāhanaṃ uṇhīsaṃ maṇiṃ vālabījaniṃ odātāni vatthāni dīghadasāni

26720.synonym: imañca, etañca, cimaṃ, cetaṃ, cesa, ceso, panesā

examples.text: acchariyaṃ, bhante, abbhutaṃ, bhante! yāva subhāsitaṃ c'idaṃ, bhante, bhagavatā
acchariyaṃ, āvuso sāriputta, abbhutaṃ, āvuso sāriputta! yāvasubhāsitaṃ c'idaṃ āyasmatā sāriputtena.
imaṃ jammaṃ nekatikaṃ, asappurisacintakaṃ, hanantu sākhaṃ sattīhi, n'āssa icchāmi jīvitaṃ.
sati gīvā siro paññā, vīmaṃsā dhammacintanā, dhammakucchisamāvāso, viveko tassa vāladhi.
alīnacitto ca siyā, na c'āpi bahu cintaye, nirāmagandho asito, brahmacariyaparāyaṇo.
sāsan'atthaṃ samuddiṭṭhaṃ, may'ākhyātaṃ samāsato, sakaṃ buddhivisesena, cintayantu vicakkhaṇā.

26733.synonym: anuvicinanta, anuvicintayanta, anuvitakkenta, cintayamāna, paccavekkhanta, vitakkenta

examples.text: atha tvaṃ pavitakkam'āgamā, manasā diṭṭhigatāni cintayanto, dhonena yugaṃ samāgamā, na hi tvaṃ sakkhasi sampayātave'ti.

26734.synonym: anuvicinanta, anuvicintayanta, anuvitakkenta, cintayanta, cintenta, paccavekkhanta, vitakkenta

examples.text: idha, bhikkhu, paṇḍito mahāpañño n'ev'attabyābādhāya ceteti na parabyābādhāya ceteti na ubhayabyābādhāya ceteti attahita-parahita-ubhayahita-sabbalokahitam'eva cintayamāno cinteti

26736.meaning1: having thought (about); having reflected (on); having considered

examples.text: atha kho, bhante, yen'atthena devā tāvatiṃsā sudhammāyaṃ sabhāyaṃ sannisinnā honti sannipatitā, taṃ atthaṃ cintayitvā taṃ atthaṃ mantayitvā vuttavacanā'pi taṃ cattāro mahārājāno tasmiṃ atthe honti.
ev'āhaṃ cintayitvāna, n'ekakoṭisataṃ dhanaṃ, nāth'ānāthānaṃ datvāna, himavantam'upāgamiṃ.

26739.commentary: (ANa) lokacintā'ti kena nu kho candimasūriyā katā, kena mahāpathavī, kena mahāsamuddo, kena sattā uppāditā, kena pabbatā, kena ambatālanāḷiker'ādayo'ti evarūpā lokacintā.

examples.text: lokacintā, bhikkhave, acinteyyā, na cintetabbā, yaṃ cintento ummādassa vighātassa bhāgī assa.
nīcā niviṭṭhā subharā, mudū atthaddhamānasā, abyāsekā amukharā, atthacintā vas'ānugā.

26740.meaning1: poet who composes by means of contemplation
26740.meaning2: who produces a poem after (considerable) thought
26740.commentary: (ANa) yo cintetvā kabyaṃ karoti, ayaṃ cintākavi nāma.

examples.text: katame cattāro? cintākavi, sutakavi, atthakavi, paṭibhānakavi, ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro kavī'ti.

26742.meaning1: developed by thinking; speculative; theoretical; imaginary
26742.commentary: (DNa) cintāmay'ādīsu ayaṃ vitthāro, tattha katamā cintāmayā paññā? yogavihitesu vā kamm'āyatanesu yogavihitesu vā sipp'āyatanesu yogavihitesu vā vijjāṭṭhānesu kammassakataṃ vā sacc'ānulomikaṃ vā rūpaṃ aniccan'ti vā… viññāṇaṃ aniccan'ti vā yaṃ evarūpaṃ anulomikaṃ khantiṃ diṭṭhiṃ ruciṃ muttiṃ pekkhaṃ dhammanijjhānakkhantiṃ parato asutvā paṭilabhati, ayaṃ vuccati cintāmayā paññā.

examples.text: aparā'pi tisso paññā, cintāmayā paññā, sutamayā paññā, bhāvanāmayā paññā.

26743.grammar: nt, in comps, pp of cinteti

examples.text: tīṇ'imāni, bhikkhave, paṇḍitassa paṇḍitalakkhaṇāni paṇḍitanimittāni paṇḍit'āpadānāni. katamāni tīṇi? idha, bhikkhave, paṇḍito sucintitacintī ca hoti subhāsitabhāsī ca sukatakammakārī ca.
pāturahosi magadhesu pubbe, dhammo asuddho samalehi cintito, apāpur'etaṃ amatassa dvāraṃ, suṇantu dhammaṃ vimalen'ānubuddhaṃ.

asappuriso, bhikkhave, assaddhammasamannāgato hoti, asappurisabhatti hoti, asappurisacintī hoti, asappurisamantī hoti, asappurisavāco hoti, asappurisakamm'anto hoti, asappurisadiṭṭhi hoti, asappurisadānaṃ deti.

26748.meaning1: should be thought about; should be reflected on; thinkable

examples.text: cattār'imāni, bhikkhave, acinteyyāni, na cintetabbāni, yāni cintento ummādassa vighātassa bhāgī assa. katamāni cattāri?
paripañhitabban'ti cintetabbaṃ tulayitabbaṃ.
idha, bhikkhu, paṇḍito mahāpañño n'ev'attabyābādhāya ceteti na parabyābādhāya ceteti na ubhayabyābādhāya ceteti attahita-parahita-ubhayahita-sabbalokahitam'eva cintayamāno cinteti
cura'icc'evam'ādito dhātugaṇato ṇe ṇaya'icc'ete paccayā honti kattari, kāritasaññā ca. coreti, corayati, cinteti, cintayati, manteti, mantayati.

26750.commentary: (DNa) atīt'ānāgatapaccuppanne atthe cintetun'ti ettha, atīte puññassa katattā'y'eva me ayaṃ sampattī'ti, evaṃ cintento atītam'atthaṃ cintetuṃ paṭibalo nāma hoti. idāni puññaṃ katvā'va anāgate sakkā sampattiṃ pāpuṇitun'ti cintento anāgatam'atthaṃ cintetuṃ paṭibalo nāma hoti. idaṃ puññakammaṃ nāma sappurisānaṃ āciṇṇaṃ, mayhañ'ca bhogā'pi saṃvijjanti, dāyakacittam'pi atthi, hand'āhaṃ puññāni karomī'ti cintento paccuppannam'atthaṃ cintetuṃ paṭibalo nāma hotī'ti veditabbo. (ANa) atthe cintetun'ti vaḍḍhi-atthe cintetuṃ. so hi paccuppanna-atthavasen'eva atīte'pi evaṃ ahesuṃ, anāgate'pi evaṃ bhavissantī'ti cinteti.

examples.text: rājā mahāvijito… bahussuto tassa tassa sutajātassa, tassa tass'eva kho pana bhāsitassa atthaṃ jānāti ayaṃ imassa bhāsitassa attho ayaṃ imassa bhāsitassa attho'ti, paṇḍito, viyatto, medhāvī, paṭibalo, atīt'ānāgatapaccuppanne atthe cintetuṃ.
yaṃnūn'āhaṃ yaṃ me tīhi māsehi dātabbaṃ siyā taṃ sabbaṃ ekadivasen'eva dadeyyan'ti cintetvā
seṭṭhi, sace me dhītā vijāyissati, tāya naṃ saddhiṃ nivesetvā seṭṭhiṭṭhānassa sāmikaṃ karissāmi. sace me putto vijāyissati, māressāmi nan'ti cintetvā taṃ gehe kāresi.

26752.synonym: anuvicinanta, anuvicintayanta, anuvitakkayanta, anuvitakkenta, cintayamāna, nijjhāyanta, paccavekkhanta, vitakkayanta, vitakkayamāna, vitakkenta

examples.text: so n'eva attabyābādhāya ceteti, na parabyābādhāya ceteti, na ubhayabyābādhāya ceteti, attahita-parahita-ubhayahita-sabbalokahitam'eva so bhavaṃ gotamo cintento nisinno hoti.
cattār'imāni, bhikkhave, acinteyyāni, na cintetabbāni, yāni cintento ummādassa vighātassa bhāgī assa. katamāni cattāri?
mahāsatto… cirakālasamparicitaṃ nekkhamm'ajjhāsayaṃ upabrūhayamāno mahantaṃ bhogakkhandhaṃ pahāya pabbajitu'kāmo hutvā puna cintesi, sac'āhaṃ pabbajissāmi, guṇasambhāvanāpākaṭo bhavissāmī'ti.

26755.synonym: imañca, etañca, cidaṃ, cetaṃ, cesa, ceso, panesā

examples.text: bahuñ'ca te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū apuññaṃ pasavanti, te c'imaṃ saddhammaṃ antaradhāpenti.

26756.meaning1: name of a fibrous plant from which cloth is made
26756.meaning2: plant from which cloth fibre is made

26757.commentary: (VINa) cimilikaṃ vā'ti-ādīsu cimilikā nāma sudh'ādiparikammakatāya bhūmiyā vaṇṇ'ānurakkhaṇ'atthaṃ katā hoti, taṃ heṭṭhā pattharitvā upari kaṭasārakaṃ pattharanti.

examples.text: seyyaṃ nāma bhisi, cimilikā uttar'attharaṇaṃ, bhūm'attharaṇaṃ, taṭṭikā, cammakhaṇḍo, nisīdanaṃ, paccattharaṇaṃ, tiṇasanthāro, paṇṇasanthāro.

26758.meaning2: strip of cloth; (under-) mat of strips of cloth(?)

examples.text: abhikkantā, bhante, ratti, nikkhanto paṭhamo yāmo, ciranisinno bhikkhusaṅgho, uddisatu, bhante, bhagavā bhikkhūnaṃ pātimokkhan'ti
seyyathā'pi, sunakkhatta, puriso sakamhā gāmā vā nigamā vā ciravippavuttho assa.

26760.commentary: (SNa) cirakatan'ti cirakālaṃ kataṃ dānaṃ vā sīlaṃ vā uposathakammaṃ vā.

examples.text: saddhassa hi, bhante, ariyasāvakassa āraddhavīriyassa etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ yaṃ satimā bhavissati, paramena satinepakkena samannāgato, cirakatam'pi cirabhāsitam'pi saritā anussaritā.
mahāsatto… cirakālasamparicitaṃ nekkhamm'ajjhāsayaṃ upabrūhayamāno mahantaṃ bhogakkhandhaṃ pahāya pabbajitu'kāmo hutvā puna cintesi, sac'āhaṃ pabbajissāmi, guṇasambhāvanāpākaṭo bhavissāmī'ti.

26762.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of cirakāla

examples.text: cirakatan'ti cirakālaṃ kataṃ dānaṃ vā sīlaṃ vā uposathakammaṃ vā. cirabhāsitan'ti asukasmiṃ ṭhāne asukaṃ nāma bhāsitan'ti evaṃ cirakāle bhāsitaṃ.

26763.meaning2: for the long standing; for the long lasting (of)

examples.text: addhānakkhamo hoti, padhānakkhamo hoti, app'ābādho hoti, asitaṃ pītaṃ khāyitaṃ sāyitaṃ sammā pariṇāmaṃ gacchati, caṅkam'ādhigato samādhi ciraṭṭhitiko hoti. ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca caṅkame ānisaṃsā'ti.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, pāsāṇe lekhā na khippaṃ lujjati vātena vā udakena vā, ciraṭṭhitikā hoti, evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco puggalo abhiṇhaṃ kujjhati. so ca khv'assa kodho dīgharattaṃ anuseti.

26766.meaning1: even longer; for even more time

examples.text: atha kho, ānanda, brāhmaṇagahapatikā rājānaṃ mahāsudassanaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evam'āhaṃsu, ataramāno, deva, yāhi, yathā taṃ mayaṃ cirataraṃ passeyyāmā'ti.

26768.meaning1: for a long time; for an extended duration
26768.construction:
cira + ratta + aṃ
ciraratta > ciratta + aṃ

examples.text: idha ce naṃ virādheti, saddhammassa niyāmataṃ, vāṇijo'va atīt'attho, cirattaṃ anutapissati.

26770.meaning1: long ordained; having been a monastic for a long time
26770.meaning2: having long since become a monk

examples.text: gandho isīnaṃ ciradikkhitānaṃ, kāyā cuto gacchatu mālutena, vicitrapupphaṃ surabhiṃ'va mālaṃ, gandhañ'ca etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhāma bhante, na h'ettha devā paṭikkūlasaññino.

26771.meaning2: not seen for a long time; seen (only) a long time ago

26772.meaning2: having sat for a long time

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, aññatarasmiṃ udakarahade mahākummakulaṃ ciranivāsī ahosi.

26774.grammar: ind, comp, abl sg of cirapaṭika
26774.meaning1: for a long time; long since
26774.commentary: (DNa) cirapaṭik'āhaṃ, bhante'ti cirato ahaṃ, cirato paṭṭhāy'āhaṃ dassanakāmo'ti attho.

examples.text: cirapaṭikā-ahaṃ, bhante, bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamitu'kāmo, n'atthi ca me kāyasmiṃ tāvatikā balamattā, yāvat'āhaṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkameyyan'ti

26775.meaning1: ordained long ago; of long standing as a monastic
26775.meaning2: having long since become a monk

examples.text: ye'pi kho te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā jiṇṇā vuḍḍhā mahallakā addhagatā vayoanuppattā therā rattaññū cirapabbajitā saṅghino gaṇino gaṇ'ācariyā ñātā yasassino titthakarā sādhusammatā bahujanassa
yāvakīvañ'ca bhikkhave bhikkhū ye te bhikkhū therā rattaññū cirapabbajitā saṅghapitaro saṅghapariṇāyakā te sakkarissanti garuṃ karissanti mānessanti pūjessanti tesañ'ca sotabbaṃ maññissanti
yam'pi, bhikkhave, tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussabhūto samāno cirappanaṭṭhe sucirappavāsino ñātimitte suhajje sakhino samānetā ahosi.

26778.meaning1: who has lived abroad for a long time; who is long absent from home
26778.meaning2: person long absent from his home

examples.text: cirappavāsiṃ purisaṃ, dūrato sotthim'āgataṃ, ñātimittā suhajjā ca, abhinandanti āgataṃ.

26779.commentary: (SNa) cirabhāsitan'ti asukasmiṃ ṭhāne asukaṃ nāma bhāsitan'ti evaṃ cirakāle bhāsitaṃ.

examples.text: saddhassa hi, bhante, ariyasāvakassa āraddhavīriyassa etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ yaṃ satimā bhavissati, paramena satinepakkena samannāgato, cirakatam'pi cirabhāsitam'pi saritā anussaritā.

26780.meaning1: rejoices for a long time; is delighted for a long duration (in)

examples.text: khajjabhojjam'atha leyya sāyiyaṃ, uttam'aggarasadāyako ahu, tena so sucaritena kammunā, nandane ciram'abhippamodati.

26781.meaning2: living for a long time; long life
26781.meaningLit: causing to go on for long time

examples.text: subhujo susu susaṇṭhito sujāto, mudutalun'aṅguliy'assa honti, dīghā tībhi purisavar'aggalakkhaṇehi, cirayapanāya kumāram'ādisanti.

26782.commentary: (DNa) cirayapanāyā'ti ciraṃ yāpanāya, dīgh'āyukabhāvāya. (DNt) cirayapanāyā'ti attabhāvassa cirakālaṃ pavattanāya. ten'āha dīgh'āyukabhāvāyā'ti.

examples.text: subhujo susu susaṇṭhito sujāto, mudutalun'aṅguliy'assa honti, dīghā tībhi purisavar'aggalakkhaṇehi, cirayāpanāya kumāram'ādisanti.
karoto cīyati pāpaṃ, cirarattāya antaka, māra nibbinda buddhamhā, āsaṃ m'ākāsi bhikkhusu.

26785.meaning1: meditatively composed for a long time; long settled (in meditation)

examples.text: dabbo cirarattasamāhito, akuhako nipako apihālu, santaṃ padaṃ ajjhagamā muni paṭicca, parinibbuto kaṅkhati kālan'ti.

26786.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of ciraratta
26786.synonym: cirakālaṃ, ciraṃ, cirāya, dīghamaddhāna, dīghamaddhānaṃ, dīgharattaṃ

examples.text: cirarattaṃ vat'ātāpī, dhammaṃ anuvicintayaṃ, samaṃ cittassa n'ālatthaṃ, pucchaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇe.
ye keci ariyaṃ dhammaṃ, vigarahantā caranti dummedhā, upenti roruvaṃ ghoraṃ, cirarattaṃ dukkhaṃ anubhavanti.

26787.meaning1: acquainted for a long time; intimately known for a long time

examples.text: asanthutaṃ maṃ cirasanthutena, nimīni sāmā adhuvaṃ dhuvena, mayā'pi sāmā nimineyya aññaṃ, ito ahaṃ dūrataraṃ gamissan'ti.

26788.grammar: ind, adv, gen sg of cira

examples.text: acir'ūpasampanno kho pan'āyasmā kassapo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahit'atto viharanto na cirass'eva, yass'atthāya kulaputtā samma'd'eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi.

26789.grammar: ind, adv, gen sg of cira, irreg
26789.meaning1: at long last; long time since; after a long time

examples.text: cirassaṃ vata passāmi, brāhmaṇaṃ parinibbutaṃ, appatiṭṭhaṃ anāyūhaṃ, tiṇṇaṃ loke visattikan'ti.
etu kho, bhante, bhagavā. svāgataṃ, bhante, bhagavato. cirassaṃ kho, bhante, bhagavā imaṃ pariyāyam'akāsi, yadidaṃ idh'āgamanāya

26790.meaning1: long time since one heard; ages since hearing

examples.text: cirassutā no, āvuso ānanda, bhagavato sammukhā dhammī kathā. sādhu mayaṃ, āvuso ānanda, labheyyāma bhagavato sammukhā dhammiṃ kathaṃ savanāyā'ti.

acir'ūpasampanno kho pan'āyasmā kassapo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahit'atto viharanto na cirass'eva, yass'atthāya kulaputtā samma'd'eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi.
dassanaṃ vā te, gāmaṇi, āgamma savanaṃ vā evaṃ te ahosi, ciravāsimātuyā chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vā'ti? evaṃ, bhante.
so khv'āhaṃ, bhante, kālass'eva vuṭṭhāya purisaṃ uyyojemi, gaccha, bhaṇe, ciravāsiṃ kumāraṃ jānāhī'ti.
